# Al's Hideaway

> Al's Hideaway is a family-owned, pet-friendly campground in Pipe Creek, Texas, in the heart of the Texas Hill Country. The property offers 13 handcrafted log cabins, 10 full-hookup RV sites, and 9 cowboy campsites on 20 scenic acres, just minutes from Bandera, Boerne, and San Antonio.

Al's Hideaway has no pet fees and no cleaning fees, and is the closest campground to the Kronkosky State Natural Area. Guests can book directly at staytexashillcountry.com and use promo code FUN for 10% off stays of 2+ nights.

## Accommodations
- [Cabins](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/cabins.html): 13 handcrafted log cabins with air conditioning, private bathrooms, and WiFi. Some include full kitchens.
- [RV & Camping](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/rv-camping.html): 10 full-hookup RV sites (20/30/50 amp) and 9 cowboy campsites for tent camping.
